meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个生物数据库间进行联合查询和ID映射
copy.tagline_en: Query 40+ bioinformatics databases with a unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple biological databases and map IDs across them

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Python 代码统一查询 40 多个生物信息学数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL），进行跨数据库检索、ID 映射、序列分析和通路分析。
howto.when: 当用户需要同时查询多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome），或进行跨数据库 ID 映射时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类 ZAP70 蛋白的序列和 KEGG 通路。
将 KEGG 化合物 C11222 映射到 ChEMBL ID。
对这段蛋白质序列做 BLAST 搜索。
say.note: Claude 会使用 NCBI BLAST 进行相似性搜索。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) via Python code, enabling cross-database searches, ID mapping, sequence analysis, and pathway analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to query multiple biological databases simultaneously (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) or perform cross-database ID mapping.

say_en.text: Look up the sequence and KEGG pathway for human ZAP70 protein.
say_en.note: Claude will call UniProt and KEGG services to return sequence and pathway info.

say_en.text: Map KEGG compound C11222 to ChEMBL ID.
say_en.note: Claude will use UniChem for cross-database ID conversion.

say_en.text: Run a BLAST search on this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will use NCBI BLAST for similarity search.
